selection_process: OMR based objective examination for 40 marks (45 minutes) Skill Test (Stenography) for 40 marks Oral interview (viva-voce) for 20 marks

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://bhupalpally.dcourts.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the District Legal Services Authority Jayashankar Bhupalpally for filling up vacant positions under its jurisdiction.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The position advertised in this recruitment notification is Steno - Typist, offering candidates an opportunity to work in a government judicial environment.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Steno - Typist post as per the official notification issued by the authority.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is offline. Candidates are required to fill out the prescribed proforma and send it by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the filled application form is 28-09-2026. Applications received after this date will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Arts, Science, Commerce or Law along with Government Technical Examination in English Shorthand and Typewriting Higher Grade.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants ranges from 18 to 44 years, with applicable age relaxations provided for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an OMR based objective examination, a skill test in stenography, and an oral interview or viva-voce.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application must be sent via Registered Post or Courier to the Chairperson, District Legal Services Authority, Nyaya Seva Sadan, District Court Premises, Jayashankar Bhupalpally.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at https://bhupalpally.dcourts.gov.in or check the important links section provided in this article for direct access.
